votes.quote: The bug: `src/safeFilename.ts:9` always adds a dot (`` `.${extension}` ``). So `safeFilename("cv", ".pdf")` returns `"cv..pdf"`, but the spec says `pdf` and `.pdf` should both give `.pdf`.
